models_evaluated: Random forest cardiovascular instability model displayed through CoMET

links.outcome: Cardiac arrest incidence and return of spontaneous circulation
links.effect: After display implementation, cardiac arrests decreased from 3.0 to 2.4 per 1000 patient days (non-significant); ROSC increased 50% (p = 0.025); arrests without ROSC decreased from 1.4 to 0.4 per 1000 patient days (p = 0.01).
links.quote: We observed a non-significant decrease in the rates of cardiac arrest events and an increase in the rate of cardiac arrests events where ROSC was achieved following the implementation of a predictive analytics display of risk scores.

unlisted_practices: Deploying a predictive early-warning analytics display with an associated clinical response protocol to reduce in-hospital cardiac arrests
